Senses.Explanation: Communal tea as an announced occasion for the assembled community. The exact word usually belongs to a compiler or narrator’s occasion line—retreat tea, evening tea, or a tea-before-address heading—while the following speech belongs to the named master; one dialogue also names communal tea as a reason for sounding the drum.
